## Purpose and scope

## Independent evidence / regression test

## Checks
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes and dist is rebuilt.
- [ ] Mathematical changes have independent reference checks.
- [ ] UI changes have native browser tests and reviewed screenshots, or a documented environment limitation.
- [ ] New historical/calibration claims have worked examples and references.
- [ ] No secrets, fonts, third-party scans or private programmes are included.
- [ ] Dependency/workflow updates have relevant checks and reviewed upstream release notes; unrun environments are stated.
- [ ] Current documentation reflects the change.
